newsitem.title: USA: American Communications mulls share offer.
newsitem.headline: American Communications mulls share offer.

text.p: American Communications Services Thursday said it is considering filing a registration statement relating to a possible underwritten public offering of its common stock.
The offering would be for the purpose of raising additional funds toward the completion of its 50-city network plan and implementation of its data and local switched services businesses.

The offering was originally set to be consummated earlier this year but was withdrawn August 6 due to stock market conditions. The offering is now expected to commence during the first quarter of 1997.
